# Glimshelf

[Glimshelf](https://glimshelf.com) is a native comic, manga, PDF, and EPUB reader for iPhone and iPad with built-in Kavita support. It connects directly to the Kavita API for library browsing, downloads, and reading-progress sync.

<Callout type="info">
  Glimshelf is currently in public beta through [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/eCSAAcQF). It requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later and Kavita 0.9.0.2 or later. The beta includes Pro features; this does not grant a permanent Pro unlock for the future App Store release.
</Callout>

## Installation

1. Install Glimshelf using the TestFlight link above.
2. Open the app and choose **Kavita** during setup.

## Setup

### Get your Auth Key

1. Sign in to your Kavita server in a web browser.
2. Open **User Settings** and find the Auth Keys section under **3rd Party Clients**.
3. Create a named Auth Key for Glimshelf and copy it. Choose an expiration suitable for your use; an expired key must be replaced in the app.

See [3rd Party Clients](../user-settings/3rdpartycilents) for Kavita's Auth Key documentation. Treat this key like a password and enter it only into apps you trust.

### Connect Glimshelf

1. Enter your **Server URL**, for example `https://kavita.example.com`. Use the server's base URL, including any configured base path.
2. Choose Auth Key authentication and paste the key into the Auth Key field.
3. Tap **Run Connection Doctor** to check connectivity and authentication.
4. When the connection check succeeds, tap **Save**. Glimshelf can then sync and display your library.

Glimshelf also offers username/password authentication and a Kavita OPDS URL option in the Kavita connection form. The OPDS URL option extracts the server address and key to establish an API connection; it does not switch the Kavita source to OPDS browsing. Generic OPDS catalogs can be added as a separate source type.

Use an address reachable from your iPhone or iPad. For remote access, use HTTPS or your private VPN connection. Your Kavita account's permissions still apply.

## Reading and progress sync

Glimshelf supports browsing Kavita libraries, reading lists, and Want to Read, with reading-progress synchronization back to Kavita. Image-based books support left-to-right, right-to-left, vertical scrolling, and double-page layouts; EPUB books use a separate EPUB reader.

Download books before going offline and wait for the downloads to finish. Offline reading progress is queued for synchronization when the server is reachable again. If the device and server have different saved progress, Glimshelf can present a choice of where to resume.

## Free and Pro

The free tier includes one connected server, reading, server progress sync, and up to five downloaded books retained at a time. Optional Glimshelf Pro adds features including unlimited servers and downloads, reading-order tools, and Bubble Zoom. See the [Glimshelf website](https://glimshelf.com) for the current feature comparison and pricing.

## Beta feedback

Send Glimshelf-specific feedback through TestFlight or the app's Support screen. Include your Glimshelf and Kavita versions and the steps needed to reproduce the problem. Do not include passwords, Auth Keys, or OPDS URLs containing keys.
